What changes from desktop, and why
Navigation goes into a hamburger menu. The
“Reservar” button leaves the header and becomes a
sticky bottom bar (see 11), inside the thumb zone.
Video is cropped to a vertical frame. The H1
breaks into three lines at 34 px so it stays the
Both CTAs stack at 52 px high and full width: easy
to tap (≥ 44 px target) and both visible above the
The surf report moves under the hero instead of
beside it. Its stats keep a compact 3 × 2 grid.
Pricing cards stack and the most-booked plan moves
to the top. The other two are compact, with “Qué
The 5 steps switch from a horizontal row to a
vertical line, which is the natural reading
Testimonials become a horizontal carousel. The
next card peeks in from the right and dots show
FAQ goes full width; long questions wrap to two
lines and the +/– icon keeps a fixed position.
Phone and WhatsApp become buttons: on a phone,
calling is one tap, which a desktop link cannot
One field per row, native date picker and level
options as 48 px tappable cards instead of small
Appears after the hero buttons scroll out of view,
so booking is always one thumb-tap away.
